tools.name: recommend_box
tools.description: The smallest box (or boxes) an order fits, with a 3D packing plan and a link to the packer's 3D view, without creating an order. Uses the account's saved product tags (fragile, soft...), packing preferences, packing rules and, unless bins are sent, its active boxes. Paid plan; a free account gets 50

tools.name: report_shipped
tools.description: Record what an order actually shipped in: its items and the box(es) used. Free and never billed. Feeds monitoring (boxes used, fill, packaging CO2, the EU 50% empty-space limit, the rough missed saving) for any warehouse system, and, for an order sent to recommend_box, whether the recommended box wa

tools.name: weekly_waste
tools.description: The last 7 days of monitored orders (free): orders, boxes used, box fill, packaging CO2e, parcels over the EU 50% empty-space limit, and a rough missed saving scaled from a solved sample. Estimates are labelled as such.

tools.name: list_boxes
tools.description: The account's boxes (inside sizes in cm), optionally one brand's. Free. GET /v1/boxes.

tools.name: save_box
tools.description: Create a box, or change the one with that id to what's sent (PUT /v1/boxes/{id}). Free. status disabled takes it out of new recommendations. Saved in the brand's WMS too where TCS-i keeps boxes in step with it.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The account's products (SKUs) with sizes and packing tags. Free. GET /v1/products.

tools.name: save_product
tools.description: Create a product, or update it with the fields sent: size, weight, packing tags (PUT /v1/products/{sku}). Free. is_flexible: soft goods that fold and squeeze; bag_allowed: may ship in a bag or mailer.

tools.name: archive_product
tools.description: Retire a product the account no longer sells (DELETE /v1/products/{sku}). Free. It's kept with its data and left out of lists and checks; save_product brings it back.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order in TCS-i, or replace it while it's open (PUT /v1/orders/{order_id}). Free. Lines are SKUs and quantities; TCS-i fills in sizes and tags from your products.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders sent through the API (create_order / POST /v1/orders), newest first, with their status and recommended boxes. Jobs a linked WMS sends are not here: list_recommendations has every job from any source. Free. GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: recommend_order
tools.description: The box(es) for an order already in TCS-i, with the packer's 3D view link. Billed like recommend_box (POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/recommend).

tools.name: mark_packed
tools.description: Record that an order was packed: in the recommended box(es) unless boxes are given (POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/packed). Free. TCS-i learns from it.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: What happened in TCS-i, oldest first: orders created, recommended, packed or cancelled, products and boxes added or changed (including sizes the assistant fixed), integrations linked. Pass after (an event id or the last next_cursor) to read on. Free. GET /v1/events.

tools.name: assistant_findings
tools.description: What TCS-i's assistant found by comparing what packers shipped with the box recommended: data it fixed itself (sizes, soft goods, bag allowed, box records; each can be undone), fixes it put back, and what needs a person. Free. GET /v1/assistant.

tools.name: decide_finding
tools.description: Act on one assistant finding: undo (put an automatic fix back), keep, done or dismiss (one for a person). Free. POST /v1/assistant/findings/{id}/{action}.

tools.name: get_packing_preferences
tools.description: The account's packing preferences: fragile on top, rotation, void fill, bags allowed, parcel preference, max parcel weight and the rest. Free. GET /v1/packing-preferences.

tools.name: update_packing_preferences
tools.description: Change some of the account's packing preferences; only the fields sent change. Applies to new recommendations. Free. PATCH /v1/packing-preferences.

tools.name: list_box_rules
tools.description: The account's box rules: orders of exactly these SKUs and quantities go in these boxes, laid out as stored. Free. GET /v1/box-rules.

tools.name: packing_kpis
tools.description: For orders packed with TCS-i's guidance: recommendation followed, box fill, and the money (missed and realised, an estimate at carrier list prices) over the last N days.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Start here when setting an account up or checking on one: what is linked, how many boxes and products it has, which integration steps are done, and `next`: the calls still to make, in order, each with why. Reads only. The same as GET /v1/setup.

tools.name: save_box_rule
tools.description: A packing rule: an order of exactly these SKUs and quantities goes in these boxes. Without id it's created; with id, replaced. auto_layout (default true) has the engine place the units so the rule is used at once; if they can't be placed the rule is still saved, with layout_problem saying why. brand

tools.name: delete_box
tools.description: Delete a box for good (one brand's copy with brand, every brand's without). To stop recommending a box but keep it, use save_box with status disabled instead.

tools.name: get_cost_settings
tools.description: The cost parameters behind the money in reports: currency, carrier discounts, labour (wage per hour, seconds), void fill price, baseline period. Free. GET /v1/cost-settings.

tools.name: update_cost_settings
tools.description: Set some cost parameters; only the fields sent change, and null puts one back to TCS-i's default. Changes the money shown in reports. Free. PUT /v1/cost-settings.

tools.name: list_recommendations
tools.description: Packing results: every box TCS-i recommended and what was actually packed, newest first, from any source (own system, a linked WMS, POST /pack). status: packed, awaiting, expired. box_state: same, bigger, smaller (box used against the one recommended). request_id returns one with its full 3D plan. d

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Why the numbers moved: the last `days` against the `days` before (1-15, from the last 30 days of packed orders). Plan followed, box fill and the fill TCS-i's own boxes would have had, for each window; then what drove the change: each brand's part in percentage points (they add up to the change), the

tools.name: explain_order
tools.description: Why one order got its box, in plain sentences: TCS-i's reasons, the box packed instead (and how much bigger or smaller), each SKU's saved size and who set it (and whether it changed since), and changes made since to its boxes or SKUs. Give request_id (from list_recommendations) or order (its order n

tools.name: list_activity
tools.description: Everything that happened on the account, newest first, as the console's activity feed: boxes, products, rules and settings changed (by whom: a person, the API or the assistant), imports, re-checks, packer flags. Use it to line changes up against when numbers moved. before pages back (the last entry'

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: A report, as the console shows it. report: summary (orders, packed, plan followed, fill), costs, box-usage, box-usage/monthly (needs month YYYY-MM), products (the ones wasting most space), brands (a 3PL's scorecard), brand-activity, product-health, data-problems.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: The account's webhooks: URL, events, on or off, last delivery. Free. GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: save_webhook
tools.description: Have TCS-i POST events (a product's size fixed by the assistant, an order recommended or packed, a box changed) to a URL of the customer's system, signed. Without id it's created and the signing secret is returned once; with id it's changed. test: true sends a test ping to the URL.

tools.description: Every public endpoint of the TCS-i REST API (docs https://www.tcs-i.com/api-docs/, OpenAPI https://api.tcs-i.com/v1/openapi.json), one line each (method, path, what it does). search narrows the list by a word ("team", "report", "webhook"); path returns that endpoint's parameters and request body. No

tools.description: Read from any GET /v1 endpoint of the TCS-i REST API (docs https://www.tcs-i.com/api-docs/, OpenAPI https://api.tcs-i.com/v1/openapi.json) with the connected account's access: what the console shows that no other tool reads (team, API keys, packing stations, notifications, re-checks, exports). Reads

tools.name: api_write
tools.description: Create or change something through a POST, PUT or PATCH /v1 endpoint of the TCS-i REST API (docs https://www.tcs-i.com/api-docs/, OpenAPI https://api.tcs-i.com/v1/openapi.json), with the connected account's access: what the console does that no other tool covers (inviting a team member, linking a WM

tools.name: api_delete
tools.description: Delete something through a DELETE /v1 endpoint of the TCS-i REST API (docs https://www.tcs-i.com/api-docs/, OpenAPI https://api.tcs-i.com/v1/openapi.json), with the connected account's access (a box rule, a webhook, a team invite, an API key). Can't be undone.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_orders, recommend_order, list_recommendations, list_activity, list_webhooks, api_get, api_write · Private data: report_shipped, mark_packed, assistant_findings, save_webhook, api_get, api_delete · Public sink: report_shipped, list_orders, recommend_order, mark_packed, decide_finding, save_box_rule, list_recommendations, save_webhook, api_reference, api_write, api_delete · Destructive: archive_product, delete_box, api_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_orders, recommend_order, list_recommendations, list_activity, list_webhooks, api_get, api_write · Private data: report_shipped, mark_packed, assistant_findings, save_webhook, api_get, api_delete · Public sink: report_shipped, list_orders, recommend_order, mark_packed, decide_finding, save_box_rule, list_recommendations, save_webhook, api_reference, api_write, api_delete · Destructive: archive_product, delete_box, api_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
